mission_summary: Blockade enforcement; air wing executed first aerial blockade interdiction May 6 — F/A-18E used M61 Vulcan 20mm cannon to disable rudder of Iranian-flagged 333m oil tanker M/T Hasna in Gulf of Oman (CENTCOM May 6). Iranian crew warned 6 hours prior. First publicly known case of an aircraft directly disabling a vessel under the blockade.
notes: Day 88 (May 26, Tuesday): On station Arabian Sea — flagship of CSG enforcing dual-blockade of Iran — UNCHANGED per USNI Fleet & Marine Tracker May 26 edition. Lincoln + Bush remain the two-CSG steady-state in CENTCOM AOR. Air Defense Commander USS Frank E. Petersen, Jr. (DDG-121, Pearl Harbor) + DESRON 21 (USS Spruance DDG-111) held. Independently deployed in 5th Fleet area: USS Milius (DDG-69), LCS Canberra/Tulsa/Santa Barbara (Bahrain — operational mine countermeasure mission packages, critically relevant given mine-laying interdiction May 25). Lincoln CSG retained primary kinetic platform under standing 'moment's notice' tasking through overnight May 25-26 CENTCOM 'self-defense' strikes on 2× IRGC mine-laying boats south of Larak Island + SAM site Bandar Abbas — platform unspecified by CENTCOM (likely F/A-18E/F or MQ-9 candidates per The Aviationist). Capt. Tim Hawkins (CENTCOM): 'U.S. forces conducted self-defense strikes in southern Iran today to protect our troops from threats posed by Iranian forces.' Iran's Mehr News framed strikes as 'under control'; FM Baghaei: 'flagrant violation' of April 8 ceasefire. IRGC (via IRNA/Fars) claims to have shot down 1× MQ-9 + 'fired upon' 2nd MQ-9, RQ-4 Global Hawk, F-35 — US official (NBC/Fox): 'no US aircraft were hit'; CENTCOM silent on platform losses; UNVERIFIED. Day 87 (May 25, Monday — MEMORIAL DAY): On station Arabian Sea — flagship of CSG enforcing dual-blockade of Iran — UNCHANGED. CENTCOM 'SELF-DEFENSE' STRIKES NEAR BANDAR ABBAS END 16-DAY ZERO-KINETIC STREAK — most significant U.S. kinetic action inside Iran since the April 8 ceasefire. Capt. Tim Hawkins (CENTCOM spokesman): 'U.S. forces conducted self-defense strikes in southern Iran today to protect our troops from threats posed by Iranian forces. Targets included missile launch sites and Iranian boats attempting to emplace mines. U.S. Central Command continues to defend our forces while using restraint during the ongoing ceasefire.' Targets: Iranian missile launch sites, Iranian boats attempting to emplace mines, and an Iranian SAM site. U.S. official described scope as 'very small'; Iran's Mehr news agency said the situation 'was under control.' Explosions also reported near Sirik and Jask. NO formal change to ceasefire status declared by either side. Lincoln CSG strike capacity remains the primary kinetic platform under the standing 'moment's notice' tasking. President Trump at Arlington National Cemetery (Memorial Day): 'In Operation Epic Fury, we lost 13 wonderful souls, wonderful special people' — first major U.S. national remembrance event since war's opening; SecWar Pete Hegseth and CJCS Gen. Dan Caine also invoked Epic Fury. SecState Rubio (NYT May 24): framework '95% there'; Trump reportedly gave Iran '5-7 days' to finalize a nuclear deal. name: USS Gerald R. Ford
area: NAVAL STATION NORFOLK — PIERSIDE. RETURNED MAY 16 (DAY 326) — LONGEST POST-VIETNAM U.S. NAVY CARRIER DEPLOYMENT. SecDef Hegseth at pier; PRESIDENTIAL UNIT CITATION awarded. USS Bainbridge (DDG-96) + USS Mahan (DDG-72) also pierside. Ford NOT TIE Midway 332-day record — final = 326 days per CNO Caudle. Ford to begin significant maintenance period; effective REMOVAL from forward-deployed status. CENTCOM retains 2 CSGs (Lincoln + Bush) + Tripoli ARG + imminent Boxer ARG.
aircraft: F/A-18E/F Super Hornets (CVW-8), EA-18G Growlers, E-2D Hawkeye
status: NORFOLK PIERSIDE (HOMEPORT) — DEPLOYMENT ENDED DAY 326; PRESIDENTIAL UNIT CITATION AWARDED 5/16
mission_summary: Returned Naval Station Norfolk Saturday May 16, 2026 after 326-day deployment — LONGEST POST-VIETNAM U.S. Navy carrier deployment. Surpassed USS Abraham Lincoln 295-day post-Vietnam record on April 15; did NOT match USS Midway 332-day all-time record (USS Nimitz 341 days 2020-21 included COVID quarantine periods, only 263 days forward-deployed per USNI). SecDef Pete Hegseth at pier presented PRESIDENTIAL UNIT CITATION (WTKR, Stars and Stripes, Defence-Industry Europe). Ford + USS Bainbridge (DDG-96) + USS Mahan (DDG-72) plus CVW-8 squadrons all home (CVW-8 returned to homeports May 11-13). Ford to begin significant maintenance period (NavyTimes May 15). EFFECTIVE REMOVAL from forward-deployed status. CSG count CENTCOM = 2 (Lincoln + Bush) + Tripoli ARG + imminent Boxer ARG. Ford CSG return ENDS one of largest cost-drivers — implies lower future daily war-burn (TBD recalibration).
notes: Day 78 (May 16, Saturday): NORFOLK PIERSIDE HOMECOMING. Ford CSG (CVN-78, DDG-96 Bainbridge, DDG-72 Mahan) returned Naval Station Norfolk after 326-day deployment — longest post-Vietnam. SecDef Hegseth at pier presented Presidential Unit Citation (WAVY, WTKR, Stars and Stripes, Straight Arrow News, Defence-Industry Europe, 13NewsNow). Did NOT match USS Midway 332-day all-time record (final = 326 days per CNO Caudle HASC testimony May 14). Hegseth took no questions on war cost. Ford to begin maintenance period. EFFECTIVE REMOVAL from forward-deployed/CENTCOM-AOR roster expected on USNI Fleet Tracker May 18. — Day 77 (May 15, Friday): Mid-Atlantic westbound, FINAL AT-SEA DAY. CNO Adm. Daryl Caudle (May 14 HASC testimony): Ford arrives Naval Station Norfolk Saturday May 16 (Day 326); SecDef Hegseth to attend welcome ceremony. Returning surface assets: Ford + USS Bainbridge (DDG-96) + USS Mahan (DDG-72). CVW-8 air wing already returned to home stations May 11-13. Per Navy Times May 15, Ford to be RECLASSIFIED from 'deployed' to 'post-deployment maintenance' upon Saturday Norfolk arrival. Two carriers (Lincoln + Bush) remain in CENTCOM AOR.
source: CNO Adm. Daryl Caudle HASC testimony May 14, Navy Times May 15 ('post-deployment maintenance' reclassification Saturday), 13News Now Norfolk, Stars & Stripes May 13, USNI Fleet & Marine Tracker, TWZ 'Where Are The Carriers'
